description: This file defines CRUD API endpoints for managing prompts in a FastAPI application, including functions for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and testing prompts, as well as converting prompt files to JSON. It interacts with in-memory prompt registry, database via Prisma, and external prompt management tools.

classes.name: Prompt
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a prompt with prompt_id, litellm_params, and optional prompt_info.

classes.name: PatchPromptRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for partial updates to a prompt, allowing optional litellm_params and prompt_info.

methods.name: get_base_prompt_id
methods.description: Extracts the base prompt ID by removing version suffixes.

methods.name: get_version_number
methods.description: Extracts the version number from a prompt ID.

methods.name: construct_versioned_prompt_id
methods.description: Constructs a versioned prompt ID from a base ID and version number.

methods.name: get_latest_version_prompt_id
methods.description: Finds the latest version of a prompt from available prompt IDs.

methods.name: get_latest_prompt_versions
methods.description: Filters a list of prompts to only include the latest version of each.

methods.name: get_next_version_for_prompt
methods.description: Determines the next version number for a prompt based on existing versions in the database.

methods.name: create_versioned_prompt_spec
methods.description: Creates a PromptSpec with a versioned prompt_id from a database prompt object.
